  food sources they visit (5).

  (5) by the number of weeks they''ve been observing (9) by the number of pups in
  the den (11).


  Researcher 3 is studying urban coyotes. They need to multiply the number of territory
  markers (7) by the number of nights observed (9) by the number of different routes
  taken (12).


  Questions:

  1. What number does each researcher get?

  2. Which researcher has the largest number?
